scientific_integrity: Exact factorial moment and convexity proof with reproducible independent rational finite-size checks; finite checks are not the infinite proof.
scientific_limitations: No joint law or new test calibration is claimed; the universal covariance sign applies to the unbiased nonuniform collision estimator, and to Pearson chi-square only for a uniform null. Some potentially related full texts were inaccessible, leaving originality risk.
title: Exact positive dependence of multinomial roughness and Pearson chi-square
